channel.title: Oceanfront Property Hunt
channel.desc: Lane and Tristan love finding homes and renovating them to their taste. This time, as they search for their forever home by the ocean, Lane wants a turn-key property so they can focus on settling in. Tristan agrees but secretly dreams of customizing another home. With the help of their best friend and realtor Susan, will they be able to find a home that makes them both happy?
